stem: A controller applies the same programmed duration to every plant, but a flow check shows several emitters deliver less water than the rest. What is the strongest response?
choices: Increase nutrient strength for the low-flow plants so reduced water volume is offset by a more concentrated solution
Measure the delivery difference and inspect pressure, clogs, emitter condition, and placement before changing the schedule
Lengthen every irrigation event enough to bring the lowest-flow emitter to target without correcting the delivery difference
Leave the schedule unchanged because reservoir pH within range indicates the irrigation system is performing adequately
rationale: Programmed duration does not guarantee uniform delivery. Measured emitter output and system condition should be investigated before changing the schedule for the entire crop.
